exposure: Stage of labor at admission (early <4 cm dilation vs. late ≥4 cm)
cohort: 188 women with a prior cesarean admitted for delivery
finding: Women with prior cesarean who presented in late labor (≥4 cm dilation) were significantly more likely to undergo a trial of labor and achieve a vaginal birth compared to those presenting in early labor.
mod_finding: Women with prior cesarean who presented in late labor (≥4 cm dilation) were significantly more likely to achieve a vaginal birth compared to those presenting in early labor.
